# posthuman-explorer-chat — provenance

- **What it is.** A ChatGPT conversation (model `gpt-5-6-thinking`), saved by Alex
  as a browser page export on 2026-09-06 and dropped into the repository root as
  `DESIGN WEB - Posthuman Explorer Design.html` plus a `_files/` folder of app CSS
  and JS. Kept here as text only; the 3 MB export itself was not committed.
- **Upstream.** No URL — a private chat. The nexu-io repositories it discusses:
  https://github.com/nexu-io (open-design, motion-anything, html-video,
  html-anything, Codex Slides, nexu).
- **Licence.** Alex's own conversation. The nexu-io tools it surveys are not
  vendored here and their licences were not checked.
- **What it actually is.** Two things: a survey of the nexu-io toolchain and where
  each tool could sit in GDBURO's process, and the drafting of
  [`GDBURO_PRODUCTION_PIPELINE.md`](../../GDBURO_PRODUCTION_PIPELINE.md) — that
  file was written in this chat and copied into the repository the same day.
- **Where it agrees with us.** Design authority above tooling; approvals and
  rejections recorded; motion refined only after composition is stable; a tool is
  never a direction.
- **Where it disagrees.** It frames Claude Code as "executor, not the default art
  director", which is narrower than `CLAUDE.md` — here the agent makes the design
  decisions autonomously under the taste system. The pipeline file inherits that
  framing; treat it as tool order, not as a limit on who decides.
- **Worth taking.** Nothing binds. The tool survey is a reading list; the
  rejection-signal list overlaps `skills/anti-patterns` and is not a candidate.
